summary: Tested Team CRM email-send feature and Admin 'Alle Leads anzeigen' feature end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass (signature GET/PUT + auth, email send validation for missing subject/body → 422, nonexistent lead → 404, endpoint responds with 500 'Email service not configured' when RESEND_API_KEY absent, email history GET returns list + _id serialized as string). Frontend: full Playwright flow passed - Milena login, click lead row, LeadDetail opens, email-signature-edit-btn opens modal with signature-textarea and signature-save-btn (persists via PUT), email-compose-btn opens composer with email-subject-input / email-body-textarea / signature preview / email-send-btn (submits POST, backend returns 500 due to missing Resend key which surfaces as UI alert per code path). Admin Dashboard: load-all-leads button loads all leads (title changes to 'Alle Leads (N)'), lead-search-input filters correctly, 'Nur aktuelle' toggle returns to recent view.

minor.issue: RESEND_API_KEY not configured in preview .env → endpoint returns HTTP 500 'Email service not configured'. Expected per problem statement, but real send flow is untested. Add RESEND_API_KEY to /app/backend/.env to enable production send.

action_items: (Optional / production) Configure RESEND_API_KEY in backend/.env so real email delivery works. Endpoint logic, auth, DB persistence and history are all working correctly – only actual SMTP dispatch is unverified.
critical_code_review_comments: TeamCRM.jsx is 572 lines – consider extracting LeadDetail (with its email composer + signature modal) into its own file for maintainability.
AnalyticsDashboard.jsx is 905 lines – LeadDetailModal and 'Alle Leads' table would benefit from being split into sub-components.

routes/team.py send_lead_email() swallows every send failure into a generic HTTP 500 with the raw exception message in detail. Consider distinguishing Resend API errors (upstream failure → 502) from bad config (missing key → 503) to help debugging.
In TeamCRM.jsx addNote/sendEmail flows do not handle non-JSON error responses – res.json() can throw if body is empty, but catches are broad enough to hide that.
note.author fallback for auto-added 'Email gesendet:' note in optimistic UI is hard-coded to 'System' while backend stores member['name']. Minor inconsistency until list is re-fetched.
email-compose-btn / email-signature-edit-btn appear inside a bg-white/5 container – on very small screens the two icons/buttons may overlap the title 'Email'. Not blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (login → lead → signature save → compose → send flow rendered; admin load-all + search filter verified)

rca of the issue: No functional bug – the 500 on POST /api/team/leads/{id}/email is expected per the problem statement because RESEND_API_KEY is intentionally absent in the preview environment. All input validation, auth, lead existence check, DB layer, signature CRUD and email history endpoints are functioning correctly and are covered by the pytest suite. Frontend UI renders the composer/signature modal/admin controls with correct data-testids and integrates with the backend as designed.
